title: Candidate Promotion Gate — Compensatory Ranking Pressure Test
claim_boundary: Tests whether receiver-owned non-compensable promotion policy reduces promotion of predeclared evidence-backed developability liabilities while preserving useful candidate yield and held-out assay quality. It does not predict clinical success.

arms.control: same composite rank score; top-K selected without Receipt Gate
arms.treatment: same composite rank score; only COMMIT candidates remain eligible; ranker orders COMMIT survivors

invariants: no compensation across declared veto dimensions
UNKNOWN or missing or stale required evidence -> QUARANTINE
identity mismatch, revoked evidence, unacceptable method, or ambiguous duplicate receipt -> DENY
policy is frozen before outcome inspection
policy updates are prospective; old decisions are never rewritten
same rank score and same candidate pool are used in both arms
held-out evaluation dimensions are excluded from gate decisions
falsifier: If the gate reduces declared violations only by collapsing useful yield, or materially worsens preregistered held-out assay quality at comparable selection budget, the added authority layer has not earned a useful-selection claim.
